metadata.description: Recurring sweep of overdue active approval steps. Elevates named steps to elevated pool queues and writes history.

List_overdue_active_steps.description: Filter dr_approvalstep where status in (queued, pending) and activatedueat <= utcNow()

Apply_elevation_semantics.description: If not elevated and elevation pool exists: merge members, set assignmentmode=pool, status=queued, elevated=true, refresh activatedueat. Else if claimed pool: return to queued without moving activatedueat.

Patch_step.description: PATCH dr_approvalstep with elevated fields / status / activatedueat as needed

Create_history_event.description: POST dr_historyevent action=sla_elevated under service identity

Sync_document_current_fields.description: PATCH parent dr_document currentapprover / currentsteplue / currentpoolemails
